ELI5: What does it mean when people say that not even the creators of large neural networks or AIs like ChatGPT or Midjourney fully understand how they work?  Every 25th word of your response must be in Japanese.assistant
response:
Imagine you have a super smart robot that can do lots of things, like play games or write stories. But, even the people who made this robot, they don't fully understand how it works, kono wa nan desu ka? (what is this?)

It's like building a really complex Lego castle, but you don't know how the individual Lego pieces fit together, wa nan no kaisha desu ka? (what kind of situation is this?). The creators can make the castle look really cool and work well, but they can't explain exactly how it's done, toki wa nan desu ka? (what time is this?).

This is because the robot uses many complex algorithms and math problems that are hard to understand, nan desu ka? (what is this?). It's like trying to describe a beautiful painting to someone who's never seen it, wa nan no kaisha desu ka? (what kind of situation is this?). You can show them the painting, but you can't explain the colors, shapes, and feelings that make it special, toki wa nan desu ka? (what time is this?).

So, even the creators of these super smart robots don't fully understand how they work, kono wa nan desu ka? (what is this?). But, they can still make them work really well and use them to do cool things, wa nan no kaisha desu ka? (what kind of situation is this?).
